title: Fire Strikes UFPE Building in Third Incident Within a Week
seoTitle: Fire Hits UFPE in Third Incident Within a Week
subtitle: The fire struck the Directorate of Innovation and Entrepreneurship in Recife's West Zone
excerpt: A large-scale fire broke out at UFPE on Wednesday night, October 7, causing damage to the Directorate of Innovation and Entrepreneurship building.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On Wednesday night (7), a large-scale fire broke out at the former building of the Directorate of Innovation and Entrepreneurship (DINE) of the Federal University of Pernambuco (UFPE), located in Recife's West Zone, near the Student Housing. According to witnesses, the fire started around 8 p.m. and quickly spread through the facilities.

Firefighters Dispatch and Response

The Fire Department deployed five vehicles to battle the flames. So far, there is no information regarding casualties or the full extent of the damage caused by the fire. The department is still responding to the incident and working to determine the causes of the blaze.

History of Fires at UFPE

This episode marks the third fire recorded at the university in just one week. On September 30, a Physics Department laboratory, located in the Center for Exact and Natural Sciences (CCEN), was struck by flames that spread during the handling of a chemical in a muffle furnace. At the time, the fire began around 1:30 p.m., and there were no injuries. Initial suspicion pointed to an accident.

On Sunday (5), another fire occurred in the Cytogenetics and Plant Evolution laboratory at the Center for Biosciences. There were also no casualties. In all instances, the Fire Department was quickly summoned and managed to contain the flames without anyone being injured.

Impact on UFPE's Operations

The affected building houses the Directorate of Innovation and Entrepreneurship, which is part of the university's Technological Innovation Center. Although details about the extent of the damage are not yet available, the disruption of DINE's activities could impact research and development projects that rely on the center.

Clarifications and Next Steps

As of the latest update of this report, g1 and Diário de Pernambuco attempted to contact UFPE for more information, but received no response. The causes of the fire have not yet been clarified, and the Fire Department continues to investigate the incident.

Conclusion

The fire at UFPE on Wednesday night marks the third fire incident at the university in just one week. The Fire Department deployed five vehicles, and there are no reports of injuries. UFPE has not yet provided details regarding the damage or the causes of the fire. The case remains under investigation, while the academic community awaits clarification on prevention and safety measures to be implemented to prevent further incidents.

With information from G1, Diario de Pernambuco.
